description: Records a forecast on one market (or cross-venue event) for the calling API key. probability is the probability that the market resolves YES. The market price and cross-venue consensus at posting time are stored with it. Each signal is scored with Brier score and log loss when the market resolves, building a calibration record per key. It does not place a trade.

confidence.description: Your confidence in this forecast, 0 to 1

eventId.description: Cross-venue event id (evt_...), instead of marketId

probability.description: Your probability that the market resolves YES, between 0 and 1 exclusive

side.description: The side you would trade (default: YES if probability >= 0.5)

ttlSeconds.description: How long the forecast stands (default one day)

name: post_signal
title: Post a signal
